description.text:
Join our ARM team to lead and shape Board Support Package (BSP) development for next-generation NXP i.MX and NVIDIA Jetson platforms.
We value engineering leaders who master the Linux stack and welcome modern, AI-assisted development paradigms to bypass legacy bottlenecks.
【Key Responsibilities】
◆ Technical Leadership & Bring-up:
Drive HW/SW co-design reviews and lead board bring-up for edge-AI and high-performance ARM SoMs.
◆ Advanced Driver Development:
Port and optimize complex subsystems (V4L2/Camera pipeline, Display, Audio, PCIe) and direct device tree architectures.
◆ Next-Gen Infrastructure:
Modernize and maintain Yocto/Debian distributions; design modular meta-layers optimized for automated CI/CD pipelines.
◆ AI-Accelerated R&D:
Pioneer AI-driven workflows (Copilot, LLMs) within the team to accelerate kernel debugging, log analysis, and architectural refactoring.
◆ Solutions Architecture:
Establish core security frameworks (Secure Boot, OP-TEE) and system performance-tuning benchmarks for strategic tier-1 customer platforms.

key_values.text:
【Requirements】
◆Languages: Expert in C/C++; proficient in Python or Shell for automation.
◆BSP Expertise: Solid experience with U-Boot, Linux Kernel, and NXP i.MX or Jetson architectures.
◆Build Systems: Proficient in Yocto Project or Buildroot.
◆DevOps: Familiar with Git (Conventional Commits) and CI/CD (Docker/Jenkins).
◆AI Literacy: Experience using AI to assist in code refactoring or troubleshooting complex kernel issues.
◆Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving logic and ability to mentor junior developers.
